result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The `*SalesRep*` tests pass, but I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `DataStore.countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, which is the same filter the other reports use. I also added "cancelled ones left out" to the method's Javadoc. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
